What We Do

What we build for our clients

Most companies have data spread across spreadsheets, separate tools, and databases nobody fully trusts. We organize it and build the reports you need to run the business.

Data Analytics

Your sales, web traffic, and customer records already hold the answers. We clean them up and report on what is actually happening in the business.

ETL & Integration

When sales, support, and inventory live in different tools, we connect them into one pipeline so nobody has to copy numbers between spreadsheets.

BI Dashboards

We build dashboards your team can filter and explore themselves, so checking last week's numbers doesn't need an analyst.

Predictive Analytics

We build forecasting models from your history to flag demand changes and churn risk early enough to act on them.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a data analytics engagement cost?
Pricing depends on scope, but most engagements start with a fixed-price discovery phase before any ongoing retainer or project cost is agreed.
How long does it take to build a BI dashboard?
A first working dashboard typically ships in 2 to 4 weeks, with iteration continuing based on stakeholder feedback.
Do you work with small businesses or only enterprises?
We work with both. Engagement scope and delivery timeline scale to the size of the data problem, not the size of the company.
What tools and platforms do you use?
We work across Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Snowflake, Redshift, PostgreSQL, Apache Airflow, dbt, and cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Can you migrate our existing data infrastructure to the cloud?
Yes, we handle cloud data migrations with a focus on zero downtime and improved scalability, typically completed alongside your existing operations.
